packageRules.description: pipeline/ : essentia-tensorflow est figé sur dev1389, dernière roue cp312 ; les versions suivantes ne publient que des roues cp314 (pipeline/docs/conception.md)
pipeline/ : Python reste en 3.12 tant qu'essentia-tensorflow n'a de roue que cp312 (règle ci-dessus)
Pins and digest re-pins carry no functional change: merged once CI passes. Automerged updates run at any time, minimumReleaseAge (14 days) is their guard, not a schedule
Minor and patch of stable dependencies (locked version >=1.0.0): covered by the site's and the pipelines' tests, merged once CI passes
0.x dependencies: a patch merges once CI passes, a minor may break and waits for review
Majors: reviewed by hand, batched into the Monday-morning window
Reviewed by hand, batched into the Monday-morning window: 0.x minors
Dev tools (npm devDependencies, uv dependency groups), 0.x included: minor and patch merge once CI passes, at any time
Docker base image tags: reviewed by hand (their digest re-pins still merge on their own, rule above)
Postgres: one image for production (site/compose.yaml) and the CI services, so one PR moves them together, reviewed by hand
Tools pipeline/scripts/dev-setup.sh downloads: their pinned SHA-256 is replaced by hand in the same PR

pnpm.overrides are security floors (`x`, `x@N`, `a>x`): a major would force a new major on packages that never asked for it. A vulnerability fixed only in a later major is fixed by upgrading the package that pulls it, by hand.
